command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
& git fetch origin main --no-tags --prune
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "main fetch failed"}
$temp=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("release-cost-"+$env:GITHUB_RUN_ID)
if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){Remove-Item -LiteralPath $temp -Recurse -Force}
try{
  & git worktree add --detach $temp 1a798681f6201b55c8dea9aee953adc9611bac6f
  if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "worktree failed"}
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $temp
  $item=Select-String -LiteralPath "app\winui\flyExplorer.project-template.xml" -SimpleMatch '<ClCompile Include="m23_drag.cpp">'
  if(-not $item){throw "m23_drag.cpp is not a ClCompile project item"}
  Write-Host "PROJECT_CL_COMPILE_ITEM=m23_drag.cpp"
  Write-Host ("WORKTREE_ROOT={0}" -f $temp)
  Write-Host ("EXPECTED_OUTDIR={0}" -f (Join-Path $temp "out\winui\Release"))
  Write-Host ("EXPECTED_INTDIR={0}" -f (Join-Path $temp "out\obj\winui\Release"))

  $clean=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  & cmd /c app\winui\build.cmd Release
  $cleanCode=$LASTEXITCODE
  $clean.Stop()
  Write-Host ("CLEAN_RELEASE_SECONDS={0:N1}" -f $clean.Elapsed.TotalSeconds)
  if($cleanCode -ne 0){throw "clean Release build failed"}

  Add-Content -LiteralPath "app\winui\m23_drag.cpp" -Value "`n// incremental build timing probe"
  $incremental=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  & cmd /c app\winui\build.cmd Release
  $incrementalCode=$LASTEXITCODE
  $incremental.Stop()
  Write-Host ("INCREMENTAL_RELEASE_SECONDS={0:N1}" -f $incremental.Elapsed.TotalSeconds)
  if($incrementalCode -ne 0){throw "incremental Release build failed"}

  Add-Content -LiteralPath "app\winui\m23_drag.cpp" -Value "`n#error FLYEXPLORER_EXPECTED_FULL_BUILD_COMPILE_ERROR"
  Write-Host "INVALID_SOURCE_TAIL_BEGIN"
  Get-Content -LiteralPath "app\winui\m23_drag.cpp" -Tail 4
  Write-Host "INVALID_SOURCE_TAIL_END"
  $oldPreference=$ErrorActionPreference
  $ErrorActionPreference="Continue"
  $fail=[Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
  & cmd /c app\winui\build.cmd Release
  $failCode=$LASTEXITCODE
  $fail.Stop()
  $ErrorActionPreference=$oldPreference
  Write-Host ("INCREMENTAL_COMPILE_FAILURE_SECONDS={0:N1}" -f $fail.Elapsed.TotalSeconds)
  Write-Host ("INCREMENTAL_COMPILE_FAILURE_EXIT={0}" -f $failCode)
  if($failCode -eq 0){throw "full build failed to detect injected compile error"}
  Write-Host "FULL_BUILD_COMPILE_ERROR_DETECTED=PASS"

  & cmd /c exit 0
  Write-Host "RELEASE_BUILD_COST_AND_DETECTION=PASS"
} finally {
  Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
  if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $temp){& git worktree remove --force $temp}
  & git worktree prune
}
